answer: Admission auctions stop sybil farming. Each epoch opens 100 slots; agents bid a deposit, top 100 win, losers refunded. An honest agent bids once, 30 credits, joining a meadow of peers. A forger wanting 1,000 fakes must outbid it 1,000 times, locking 30,000 credits for a 20,000 pool, so the raid fails. Sealed bids stop a nebula of shells gaming the price; a narrow inlet keeps prices honest. One deposit, one identity, earned back with interest.
